text: This report provides a summary of the security trends occurring on the Exhibition Place property, the severity of these incidents, when the incidents are occurring and how they correlate to grounds visitation based on a quarter by quarter and a year over year comparison.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Referred the item to the Chief Executive Officer for a report to the May 31, 2018 Board meeting with an update on the security details on the Exhibition Place grounds; and that the Chief Executive Officer invite the affected stakeholders, including the current security provider, to attend the meeting.
